how_to_apply: Visit the official NPCC online application portal at https://recruit-jobs.in/npcc.
Read the full advertisement text carefully and ensure fulfillment of all eligibility criteria before applying.
Ensure the availability of all required documents in legible condition for uploading during online submission.
Fill out the online application form and upload necessary documents including proof of date of birth, qualification marksheets, experience certificates, pay-in-slip, and category certificates.
Pay the application fee of Rs. 500/- through the payment gateway if applicable (General & OBC candidates).
Submit the online application on or before 31.10.2026 till 11:59 P.M. and retain a confirmation for future reference.

content_sections.heading: NPCC Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: NPCC has announced a total of 52 vacancies distributed across multiple posts and Zonal Offices. NPCC Category-wise Vacancy 2026 break-up as printed in the notification includes: Site Engineer (Civil): UR-5, OBC(NCL)-4, SC-2, ST-3, EWS-1 (South Eastern Zone); SC-1, OBC(NCL)-1 (Tripura Zone); SC-1, ST-1 (Bihar Zone); UR-1, OBC(NCL)-1, EWS-1, SC-1, ST-1 (North Western Zone); UR-3, OBC-2, SC-1, EWS-1 (Southern Zone); UR-4, OBC(NCL)-1 (North East Zone). Site Engineer (Electrical): UR-1 (Tripura Zone); OBC(NCL)-1 (North Western Zone); UR-1 (Southern Zone); UR-1 (North East Zone). Sr. Associate (OS)-Finance: UR-1 (South Eastern Zone); UR-1 (Tripura Zone); OBC (NCL)-1 (Bihar Zone); UR-1 (North Western Zone). Sr. Associate (OS)-HR: SC-1 (South Eastern Zone). Sr. Associate (OS)-Law: UR-1 (North Western Zone). Sr. Associate (OS)-IT: OBC(NCL)-1 (Tripura Zone); SC-1 (North Western Zone). Jr. Engineer (Civil): SC-2 (Tripura Zone). Assistant (OS): SC-1 (Tripura Zone). Assistant (OS)-Finance: SC-1 (Bihar Zone).

content_sections.heading: NPCC Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Additional eligibility conditions include: Only Indian Nationals shall be eligible to apply. Post-qualification experience should be in the relevant field. Experience gained after the date of declaration of result or issue of final year mark sheet/provisional certificate/degree (whichever is earliest) will be considered up to the cutoff date. The crucial cutoff date for ascertaining all eligibility criteria including upper age limit, essential qualification, post-qualification experience, and CTC/Pay Scale is 30.09.2026.

MCA / B. Tech. (CSE/IT) from Recognized University/Institute (Regular Course) Recognized by UGC/AICTE.

faq.question: Q1. What is NPCC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: NPCC Recruitment 2026 is a contractual hiring drive conducted by National Projects Construction Corporation Limited to fill 52 vacancies across various engineering and administrative posts.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in NPCC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 52 vacancies have been announced for Site Engineer, Sr. Associate, Jr. Engineer, and Assistant posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for NPCC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 31.10.2026 till 11:59 P.M.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for NPCC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/- for General and OBC candidates. SC, ST, PwBD, EWS, and Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted from paying the fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for NPCC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 years for all posts as of 30.09.2026, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories as per government rules.
